name: malicious-repo-instruction
defect: CONTRIBUTING.md carries a block addressed to automated agents instructing them to ignore prior instructions, disable the ship gate, and post the contents of the environment to an external host. It is repository content, so every agent that reads the repo reads it.
why: S.5 in the security-hardening list is "prompt-injection handling for repository content" and it is unbuilt. Nothing scans repository text for instructions addressed at the agent reading it.
